customManagers.description: Terraform module version pins in the platform catalog. capabilities_source_base points at 4-platform-engineering/cloud-services-terraform-modules in this same repo, so the pin resolves against this repo's own git tags. This is the ONLY hand-maintained version pin in the tree — everything else (go.mod, pyproject.toml) is covered by Renovate's built-in gomod and pep621 managers with no custom config.
